title: Jazmín Calimano Colón
text: Jazmín transitioned from scientific research, holding a B.S. in Chemistry, into the civic tech space to merge her technical background with her dedication to community building. Based in Chicago and pursuing a degree in Civic Analytics, she is passionate about leveraging data research with R to uncover insights, solve urban challenges, and elevate nonprofit and civic initiatives.
